headline: Week nine: Build opens with running back, vert near par
narrative: First week of Build, and the vert landed a whisker under target — close enough to call it done. The climbing was heavily front-loaded: treadmill elevation sessions on Monday and Tuesday did most of the lifting, then the middle of the week went flat — rowing and walking only, three straight days with no on-foot work — before the weekend pulled it back with parkrun and a proper trail run over Sponds Hill and Higher Moor. Time on feet came in under the ask, and that mid-week hole is why.

The week's real assignment was run reintroduction if cleared, and the answer was a clear yes: Monday's club run, treadmill running twice, a quick parkrun, and Sunday's hilly trail outing — the fullest week of running since rehab began, and a second straight week without a word from the calf. Next week asks for the blend proper: mixing run and hike with a genuine back-to-back weekend, and a step up in both vert and hours. The reintro held; now spread the load across the whole week and build on it.
